wealthsimple.name: wealthsimple
wealthsimple.description: Read-only Wealthsimple portfolio access via GraphQL API. Commands: login, otp <code>, accounts, balances, holdings, history, transactions [account]. Also supports spending analysis.

home-assistant.name: home-assistant
home-assistant.description: Home Assistant REST API client. Control lights, switches, climate, sensors, and all HA entities. Supports: status, states, services, entity control, automation triggers.
home-assistant.usage: home-assistant status | home-assistant states | home-assistant call light.living_room toggle

fb-marketplace.name: fb-marketplace
fb-marketplace.description: Search Facebook Marketplace listings, monitor deals, and chat with sellers. Uses authenticated Facebook GraphQL API.

vision.name: vision
vision.description: Analyze images using a vision-capable LLM. Supports local OAI-compat models (qwen3.5-vl, llava, etc.) and any OAI-compat vision endpoint. Usage: vision analyze <image_url_or_path> [prompt], vision config [--model <model>] [--provider <url>]. Default prompt describes the image; customize for specific tasks like furniture style identification.
vision.usage: python3 /workspace/tools/vision.py analyze https://example.com/photo.jpg "Is this mid-century modern?"

amazon.name: amazon
amazon.description: Search Amazon.ca product catalog and view order history using authenticated session. Use when user asks to find, search, or buy products on Amazon, check order history, or compare products.

uber-eats.name: uber-eats
uber-eats.description: Browse, search, and order from Uber Eats. View order history, search restaurants, browse menus, build carts, and reorder past favorites. Locked to 150 April Rd, Port Moody, BC.
